content.text:
Yes, the tests pass: all 3 pass and none fail.

The bug was in `cartTotal` in `src/cart.js`. It used `Math.floor` on the discount, so 157.5 became 157 instead of 158. It now rounds half up with `Math.floor((2 * subtotal * percent + 100) / 200)`. That stays in integer math, so floating-point error can't affect the rounding. I didn't change `lineTotal`, the no-discount path, the test or any dependencies.
